BL-1507 — Swarm stamp-off: hotfix a4b30d454b made the launcher's opt-in b.ai guard set the b.ai base unconditionally (base follows key), after a coordinator pane respawned with a stale Cerebras base presented the b.ai key to api.cerebras.ai and failed every aider turn - review the landed diff, confirm or refute, open narrow follow-ups; never rewrite it and never write the ledger decision
What it solves: ## What
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What needs sign-off is the DISPOSITION only: that reviewing the landed diff of a4b30d454b (BL-811 / BL-849 posture) rather than re-implementing it is right, and that medium is the right sever…
BL-1507 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1507" (or "reject BL-1507 <reason>") to act.
